title: Capacity onboarding — human-in-the-loop escalation & approval playbook
creator: Arielle Park
description:
Problem: Customers booking Dedicated capacity currently get routed through an automated intake that only supports simple thresholds. For large enterprise commitments we need a deterministic human-in-the-loop (HITL) escalation and approval path that integrates forecasting, temporary burst allowances, and an SLA handshake.

Goal: Ship a playbook and UI/automation that lets sales/solutions engineers and capacity ops evaluate requests with a) transparent eligibility questionnaire, b) staged approvals (auto-approve, SE-review, capacity-ops sign-off), c) an emergency burst lane for short-term burst capacity with defined audit controls, and d) a weekly forecasting cadence that reconciles committed throughput to fleet capacity.

Scope: Intake forms, approval ladder, approval time SLAs, audit log entries, escalation rules for requests that exceed autorelease thresholds, UI annotations in Console for pending decisions, and metrics to feed forecasting dashboards. This ticket covers the playbook, acceptance criteria and handoff to ENG and Design. Implementation tickets will be split (ENG + DES).
acceptance_criteria: Intake questionnaire template created with sections: workload profile, latency SLOs, 99th percentile token rate, peak burst needs, data residency, and security constraints
Approval ladder defined: auto-approve < X throughput and < Y burst minutes; SE review lane for medium requests; capacity-ops sign-off required for > Z or enterprise legal/finance flagged
HITL escalation rules with SLAs: 4h SE response target, 24h ops sign-off target; time-to-approve metrics appear in Console
Emergency burst lane documented with maximum burst duration, cost override procedure, and mandatory postmortem checklist
Audit log schema defined (who approved, when, which artifacts) and linked to customer account in Console
Forecasting cadence document that maps weekly demand signals to fleet auto-provision suggestions; dashboard queries and owners assigned
Clear handoff doc to ENG with PRD links and stubbed API contract for approval actions
discussion: 2026-03-10 AP: Initial draft; flagged need to avoid manual spreadsheet workflows — prefer Console-integrated flow (questionnaire + approval buttons).
2026-03-11 DM: Engineering concerned about adding long-running approval transactions; propose ephemeral approval tokens with idempotency keys. Added dependency ENG-1842 for approval API work.
2026-03-12 MC (Solutions Eng): Suggest adding a ‘temporary burst’ checkbox for proof-of-concept customers, limited to 72 hours and with auto-revoke — reduces churn when onboarding proof workloads.
2026-03-13 JG (Legal): Requests that we require finance sign-off for commitments > $250k ARR; routing rule added to playbook.
2026-03-14 AP: Consolidated acceptance criteria and added forecasting cadence. Ready for design review and to split implementation tickets.
decision_log: Decision 2026-03-11: Use staged approvals rather than purely manual sign-off to reduce latency and provide clear audit trails.
Decision 2026-03-12: Temporary burst lane capped at 72 hours and requires billing owner acknowledgement.
Decision 2026-03-13: Financial threshold set at $250k ARR for mandatory finance review.
Decision 2026-03-14: Require security review because audit logs will surface customer sensitive metadata.
